idea: Healthy habits (BATHROOM, bedtime): Baby Jimmy grins a funny chocolate grin ('Oh no! Chocolate on my teeth!') and Baby Ava gasps and points; Mommy Lily brings the toothbrushes with a tiny pea of toothpaste; Jimmy and Ava brush 'Up and down! Round and round!' (copy-me); they show shiny clean smiles, Ava points at her teeth and asks the viewer 'What do we brush?' (pause) – 'Our teeth! Shiny, clean teeth!'; lesson 'Morning and night, brush your teeth!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now with clean sparkling teeth and bye-bye waves.
lesson: Brush your teeth up and down, morning and night, to make them shiny and clean.
calendar: Monday slot 2 – Healthy habits (brush teeth). Brush-your-teeth song was on the idea bank and never made.
characters: Jimmy (PAJAMAS): BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing soft light blue pajamas with tiny yellow stars and moons, barefoot.

Ava (PAJAMAS): BABY AVA: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby girl with short fluffy curly brown hair, one small curly ponytail on top with a sparkly pink star hair clip, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks. wearing soft pink pajamas with tiny yellow stars, barefoot.

Mommy Lily (HOME): MOMMY: a kind young mother in 3D Pixar style, blonde hair in a messy high bun with loose curly strands around her face, big bright blue eyes, rosy cheeks, gentle sweet smile. wearing a loose soft coral oversized short-sleeve t-shirt, light blue wide-leg loose jeans, white sneakers and small gold hoop earrings.
setting: BATHROOM: a bright bathroom with light blue walls and tiles, a round white bathtub with bubbles, a yellow rubber duck, fluffy yellow and pink towels with white flowers, a flower-shaped yellow and pink bath mat, a round wooden mirror, a white sink cabinet with a blue cup with a blue toothbrush and a pink cup with a pink toothbrush, and a small wooden step stool.

learning.goal: Brush your teeth – up and down, round and round – morning and night.
learning.shown_how: Chocolate smudges on Jimmy's teeth (shots 1-2) → both babies brush with blue and pink toothbrushes and a little foam (shot 3) → big shiny clean white smiles with sparkles (shots 4-5).
learning.interactive_moment: 0:15-0:18 'What do we brush? Hmm?' (Ava points at her teeth, question boing) + 0:18-0:20 humming pause → answer 'Our teeth!' at 0:20
learning.copy_me: 0:08-0:12 'Up and down! Round and round!' – kids brush with a pretend toothbrush
learning.fact_check: Pea-size toothpaste on the brushes (correct amount for small kids); one own toothbrush each (blue = Jimmy, pink = Ava); exactly two toothbrushes in every frame; brushing motion up/down + circles; brush morning and night (correct guidance).
learning.modeling: Chocolate on the teeth is a gentle funny mistake corrected right away by brushing with Mommy's help; kids brush themselves, Mommy praises them.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, bright calm bathroom, nothing scary or gross (small soft chocolate smudges), faces large.

fun_mechanics: copy-me: brush up and down, round and round
interactive pause: What do we brush?

story_order.chocolate on Jimmy's teeth: shots 1-2 present · shot 3 being brushed (foam, gone) · shots 4-5 absent (clean)
story_order.toothbrushes out of the cups: shot 1 in cups · shot 2 in hands (Jimmy blue, Mommy pink), cups empty · shot 3 in mouths, cups empty · shots 4-5 back in cups

shots.role: problem / help arrives: Mommy brings the toothbrushes
shots.frame: f2 r4 (r0/r1 had 3 toothbrushes or brushes still in cups; r2 Mommy's hand on Jimmy's shoulder → C1 content-rejected the image 4x; r3 lost the chocolate; r4 chocolate restored)

shots.role: doing it: brush up and down, round and round
shots.frame: f3 r1 (r0 had brushes still in the cups)

shots.role: solution + question: clean smiles, 'What do we brush?'
LOOP ENDING – mirror shot 1, clean teeth, bye-bye
